import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductComparison

/-!
# The first-factor retraction on circle-product cohomology

Restriction to a punctured-circle chart, followed by its projection equivalence,
retracts pullback from the first factor. The two chart coordinates of a global
class coincide, by the Mayer--Vietoris difference calculation.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- Pullback on integral cohomology by the first projection of a circle product. -/
def circleProductCohomologyPullback (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology X n →ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) n :=
  singularCohomologyPullback (TopCat.ofHom ⟨Prod.fst, continuous_fst⟩) n

/-- Retraction onto the first factor obtained by restriction to a circle chart. -/
def circleProductCohomologyRetraction (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) n →ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSingularCohomology X n :=
  (circleProductChartCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (singularCohomologyPullback
      (singularSubsetInclusion (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (circleProductChart X v)) n)

/-- Restricting a first-factor pullback and using chart coordinates recovers the class. -/
theorem circleProductCohomologyRetraction_left_inverse (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) :
    Function.LeftInverse (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v n)
      (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n) := by
  intro c
  have h : (singularCohomologyPullback
      (singularSubsetInclusion (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (circleProductChart X v)) n).comp
      (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n) =
      (circleProductChartCohomologyEquiv X v n).toLinearMap := by
    unfold circleProductCohomologyPullback
    rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_comp]
    rfl
  change (circleProductChartCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm
    (((singularCohomologyPullback
      (singularSubsetInclusion (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (circleProductChart X v)) n).comp
        (circleProductCohomologyPullback X n)) c) = c
  rw [h]
  exact (circleProductChartCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm_apply_apply c

/-- A global class has equal first-factor coordinates on the two circle charts. -/
theorem circleProductMayerVietoris_restriction (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
    singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
      (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v)) n ≫
      (biprod.mapIso (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X v n)
        (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X (-v) n)).inv =
      biprod.lift (ModuleCat.ofHom (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v n))
        (ModuleCat.ofHom (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v n)) := by
  let r := singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
    (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v)) n ≫
    (biprod.mapIso (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X v n)
      (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X (-v) n)).inv
  have hzero : r ≫ biprod.lift (biprod.fst - biprod.snd)
      (biprod.fst - biprod.snd) = 0 := by
    rw [← circleProductMayerVietoris_difference X v n]
    dsimp [r]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
      singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction_difference_assoc, zero_comp]
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ biprod.fst) hzero
  simp only [Category.assoc, biprod.lift_fst, zero_comp,
    Preadditive.comp_sub] at hcoord
  have heq : r ≫ biprod.fst = r ≫ biprod.snd := sub_eq_zero.mp hcoord
  have hfst : r ≫ biprod.fst =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v n) := by
    dsimp [r]
    simp only [Category.assoc, biprod.mapIso_inv, biprod.map_fst]
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    simp only [singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction, biprod.lift_fst]
    rw [← singularCohomologyPullback_eq_homologyMap]
    rfl
  change r = _
  apply biprod.hom_ext
  · simpa only [biprod.lift_fst] using hfst
  · simpa only [biprod.lift_snd] using heq.symm.trans hfst

end Mumford.Analytic
